ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows an angle with vertex W and two sides passing through X on the left side and Y on the right side. Segment WZ is drawn inside the angle, and the two magenta arcs at W indicate that WZ bisects angle XWY. Segments ZX and ZY are drawn from Z to the sides of the angle, with right-angle markers at X and Y showing ZX and ZY are perpendicular to the angle sides. The segment XZ is labeled 3x + 5, and the segment YZ is labeled 5x - 7. Reasoning: Since Z lies on the angle bisector WZ, its perpendicular distances to the two sides of the angle are equal. Therefore XZ = YZ, so 3x + 5 = 5x - 7. Solving gives 12 = 2x, so x = 6. Then XZ = 3x + 5 = 3(6) + 5 = 23.
